faq.q: Which school district serves Maple Ridge, including its acreage areas?
faq.a: SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows; catchments are address-based and there is no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) — at the downtown sample address used here (11897 227 Street) the locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary; confirm any acreage address with the SD42 School Locator.
